To make the **"Commune"** title stand out artistically and elevate the overall visual appeal, here are some enhancements using Chakra UI, including a gradient background, text shadow, and a custom font if desired.

Here’s a modified version of your `Text` block, plus the full enhanced component below:

---

### 🔥 Suggested Improvements:
- Gradient text for the title
- Drop shadow for more depth
- Optional font (e.g., a stylized one like `'Pacifico'` or `'Dancing Script'` if installed)

---

### ✨ Enhanced Component Code:

```jsx
import React from 'react';
import {
  Container,
  Box,
  Text,
  TabList,
  TabPanel,
  TabPanels,
  Tab,
  Tabs,
} from '@chakra-ui/react';
import Login from '../Components/Authentication/Login';
import Signup from '../Components/Authentication/Signup';

const HomePage = () => {
  return (
    <Container maxW="xl" centerContent>
      <Box
        display="flex"
        justifyContent="center"
        alignItems="center"
        p={4}
        bg="white"
        w="100%"
        m="40px 0 15px 0"
        borderRadius="lg"
        borderWidth="1px"
        boxShadow="lg"
      >
        <Text
          fontSize="5xl"
          fontWeight="extrabold"
          bgGradient="linear(to-r, teal.500, green.400, blue.500)"
          bgClip="text"
          fontFamily="'Segoe UI', 'Pacifico', cursive"
          textAlign="center"
          textShadow="2px 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)"
        >
          Commune
        </Text>
      </Box>

      <Box
        bg="white"
        w="100%"
        borderRadius="lg"
        borderWidth="1px"
        p={4}
        boxShadow="md"
      >
        <Tabs variant="soft-rounded" colorScheme="blue">
          <TabList mb="1em">
            <Tab width="50%">Login</Tab>
            <Tab width="50%">Sign Up</Tab>
          </TabList>
          <TabPanels>
            <TabPanel>
              <Login />
            </TabPanel>
            <TabPanel>
              <Signup />
            </TabPanel>
          </TabPanels>
        </Tabs>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  );
};

export default HomePage;
```

---

### 📌 Notes:
- To use a custom Google Font like `'Pacifico'` or `'Dancing Script'`, add it in your `index.html` or via `@import` in your CSS:
  
```html
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Pacifico&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

or in CSS:

```css
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Pacifico&display=swap');
```

Then set `fontFamily="'Pacifico', cursive"` in Chakra.

---

Perfect. Here's how to **upgrade the "Commune" title** with:
1. A **better font** (we’ll use `Pacifico` for a friendly handwritten style – you can swap it later if you prefer a more modern or futuristic one).
2. A **subtle animation** using `framer-motion` to make the title pop smoothly when the page loads.

---

### ✅ Updated Steps:

#### 1. **Install `framer-motion`** (if not already):
```bash
npm install framer-motion
```

#### 2. **Add the Google Font (`Pacifico`)**  
In your `public/index.html`, inside `<head>`:
```html
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Pacifico&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

---

### 🎨 Final Code (With Font + Animation)

```jsx
import React from 'react';
import {
  Container,
  Box,
  Text,
  TabList,
  TabPanel,
  TabPanels,
  Tab,
  Tabs,
} from '@chakra-ui/react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import Login from '../Components/Authentication/Login';
import Signup from '../Components/Authentication/Signup';

const MotionText = motion(Text);

const HomePage = () => {
  return (
    <Container maxW="xl" centerContent>
      <Box
        display="flex"
        justifyContent="center"
        alignItems="center"
        p={4}
        bg="white"
        w="100%"
        m="40px 0 15px 0"
        borderRadius="lg"
        borderWidth="1px"
        boxShadow="lg"
      >
        <MotionText
          fontSize="5xl"
          fontWeight="bold"
          fontFamily="'Pacifico', cursive"
          bgGradient="linear(to-r, #00B5D8, #38A169)"
          bgClip="text"
          textShadow="1px 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)"
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -20, scale: 0.9 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: 'easeOut' }}
        >
          Commune
        </MotionText>
      </Box>

      <Box
        bg="white"
        w="100%"
        borderRadius="lg"
        borderWidth="1px"
        p={4}
        boxShadow="md"
      >
        <Tabs variant="soft-rounded" colorScheme="blue">
          <TabList mb="1em">
            <Tab width="50%">Login</Tab>
            <Tab width="50%">Sign Up</Tab>
          </TabList>
          <TabPanels>
            <TabPanel>
              <Login />
            </TabPanel>
            <TabPanel>
              <Signup />
            </TabPanel>
          </TabPanels>
        </Tabs>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  );
};

export default HomePage;
```

---

### 🧪 You’ll See:
- The **"Commune"** title now slides down and fades in with a smooth animation.
- The **`Pacifico` font** gives it a creative, friendlier vibe.
- Gradient color and slight shadow add polish.

---

### 🎯 Your Goal:
You want the **white card (Login block)** to:
- **Shrink to the height of its content only**
- **Not** have `min-height: 40vh` (as seen in the DevTools on `.css-1bpgm8q`)
- Basically, **no forced vertical height** — just naturally fit the form

---

### 🔥 The Culprit:
The class `.css-1bpgm8q` (auto-generated by Chakra) has:

```css
min-height: 40vh;
```

This is **likely coming from a Chakra `Flex` or `Box`** component that you haven’t customized.

---

### ✅ Exact Fix:

Change this section of your code:

```jsx
<Box
  bg="white"
  w="100%"
  borderRadius="lg"
  borderWidth="1px"
  p={4}
  boxShadow="md"
  height="fit-content"
>
```

To:

```jsx
<Box
  bg="white"
  w="100%"
  borderRadius="lg"
  borderWidth="1px"
  p={4}
  boxShadow="md"
  minH="unset"
  h="fit-content"
>
```

> ✅ `minH="unset"` overrides the Chakra default of `min-height: 40vh`  
> ✅ `h="fit-content"` ensures it fits your login/signup form height perfectly

---

### 💡 Optional (if still persists):
Check if you're using a parent `Flex` or `Box` like this:

```jsx
<Flex justify="center" align="center" minH="40vh">  ← REMOVE THIS
```

Make sure you:
- Either **remove `minH`**
- Or replace with `minH="auto"` or `unset`

```jsx
        <Login />
      </TabPanel>
      <TabPanel px={0}>
        <Signup />
      </TabPanel>
    </TabPanels>
  </Tabs>
</Box>
```
